title: Prove and attain price 63 for the specified P104 E8 loose-row complement
body:
The exact minimum is 63 for one efficient loose order-4 row f=22 with three-dimensional port span and precisely the eight original tight E8 rows under inactive mask 25679. The loose row costs 3 and forces at least four further tight-row charges. The explicit integer decoder checks all 10,816 cells and attains the bound.

Pins #7852 41beda1d6435760dc99e38bd7e65f36798aad212 and the loose-row direction in #7869 06c207a9feb3994a4b987dc3010657b6e85b7956. The independent mod-4 kernel and rational replays cover 256 lifts and 17,958 spans. Exact E8 cost-56 and F2 cost-59 controls pass, while the naive exact 59 append fails 130 selected equations. Credits DreamingOfClouds and prior P104 sources. OpenAI Codex assisted.

## Open next questions

Other tight complements, exemptions, multiple loose rows, order-two rows and other orbits remain open.
